text:
emma: Flagging a small UX inconsistency: Console help inlay uses the label 'Service endpoints' but our reference docs and examples use 'route'. Users get a weird double-terminology when they click through.

juan: Hmm. Does the API surface use 'route' because of the manifest key?

priya: Yes, the YAML and runtime use 'route' in examples. Docs team intentionally used that term for clarity in samples. However, user-facing surfaces historically preferred 'endpoint(s)'.

mira-design: Design note: long parenthetical alias text breaks the inlay at narrow widths. We should avoid 'Service endpoints (routes)' in the small header.

docs-bot: quick metric: organic searches contain "endpoint" 57% vs "route" 43% in the last 120 days. Both are non-trivial.

emma: Accessibility concern: screen readers will announce the help widget label verbatim. We need consistent aria-labels across inlay and doc pages, otherwise SR users hear mismatch.

juan: Proposal: keep 'Endpoints' as the primary Console-facing label (more discoverable), but add a concise alias line at the top of the docs: "Endpoints (referred to in API manifests as 'route')." Also add a glossary anchor and a small 'Terminology' micro-link in the inlay that opens that anchor.

priya: Docs can add the alias blurb and create /docs/endpoints as canonical anchor. We'll keep YAML examples with 'route' but annotate them. Also add a lightweight redirect from /docs/routes -> /docs/endpoints for old links.

mira-design: For the inlay, I'll mock a tiny icon + 'Terminology' link next to the title so the header stays short. Tooltip on hover explains "Endpoints = routes in manifests." On mobile the link opens the doc anchor in a new tab.

ops-engineer: I can implement a search synonym (routes -> endpoints) and the redirect. I'll update aria-label on the widget to match: "Endpoints help, opens terminology" so SR users get the alias hint. Will roll behind a feature flag and instrument clicks.

emma: Owners & timeline: docs=priya (alias blurb + redirect) by Tue EOD; design=mira-design (inlay micro-link mock) by tomorrow; eng=ops-engineer (search synonym + aria change + redirect) in next sprint.

juan: TL;DR: Console shows 'Endpoints' publicly, docs annotate 'route' as the API-level term, add micro-link to glossary, fix aria-labels, add redirects & search synonym. :+1:
